scripts.translation:
您携带的物品过多，无法继续任务。
请减轻负重后再试一次。

scripts.translation: 公会副本每日任务

scripts.text: About quests

scripts.text: I don't need it.
scripts.translation: 我不需要。

scripts.text:
{0}
If you have luck on your side, you'll have good results.
scripts.translation:
{0}
如果运气好，结果就会不错。

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来。

scripts.text: Let's check right now!
scripts.translation: 现在查看！

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm sorry but you can complete this mission only during the siege hours. I'm afraid I can't do anything here.
scripts.translation:
{0}
很抱歉，您只能在攻城战期间完成此任务。恐怕我无能为力。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Give up the quest.
scripts.translation: 放弃任务

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm not sure how long you can use the guild dungeon, but good luck.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我不确定您能使用公会副本多久，但祝您好运。

scripts.text:
{0}
Well, no one's forcing you.
Do whatever you like to do.
I'll cancel the mission then.
scripts.translation:
{0}
好吧，没人强迫您。
请随意。
那么，我将取消该任务。

scripts.text:
{0}
I have confirmed that the waiting time for this mission is over.
I'll delete the records used for confirmation.
Now, give it a try to complete the quest!
scripts.translation:
{0}
我已确认此任务的等待时间已结束。
我将删除用于确认的记录。
现在，请尝试完成任务吧！

{0}
好吧，随您便。

If you are a master of a guild that is currently participating in siege battles, you should give it a try.
scripts.translation:
{0}
如果您是正在参加攻城战的公会的会长，建议您尝试一下。

scripts.text:
{0}
You're really something else~!
scripts.translation:
{0}
您真是与众不同呢~！

scripts.text: It is to deal with the powerful creatures that appear in the Corridor of the Abyss.
scripts.translation: 任务是处理出现在深渊回廊中的强大生物。

scripts.text: It is to eliminate the monsters that appear in the guild dungeon.
scripts.translation: 任务是消灭出现在公会副本中的魔物。

scripts.text: You should hunt 50 or more Caterpillars and Creamy Fear monsters..
scripts.translation: 您需要猎杀50只或以上的狂暴绿棉虫和狂暴克瑞米。

scripts.text: Hunt down 30 or more of all 3 types of Abyss Kobolds.
scripts.translation: 猎杀30只或以上的所有3种深渊刺锤犬妖。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffYou should kill furious 'Pyuriel' and warrior 'Lora'.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff您需要击败狂暴的'Pyuriel'和战士'Lora'。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 or more of Giant Hornets and Ancient Worms, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别猎杀50只或以上的狂暴蜂兵和狂暴蜈蚣。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 40 or more of Killer Mantises and 50 or more of Angra Mantises.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff猎杀40只或以上的杀手螳螂和50只或以上的安格拉螳螂。^000000

scripts.text: They are ^4d4dff'Elvira' and 'Gioia,' which is a strange mechanical creature of heroes' tears.^000000
scripts.translation: 它们是^4d4dff'埃维亚'和'乔伊亚'，一种由英雄之泪构成的奇异机械生物。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 or more Zombie Masters and Wraith Deads, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别猎杀50只或以上的腐尸首领和狂暴恶灵。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 GLD_DARK_SHADOW, 20 GLD_DARK_FRAME, and 20 GLD_DARK_PRIEST monsters.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff猎杀50只GLD_DARK_SHADOW、20只GLD_DARK_FRAME和20只GLD_DARK_PRIEST。^000000

scripts.text: They are ^4d4dff'Kades' and 'Rudo' who wander around the dead's hill.^000000
scripts.translation: 它们是^4d4dff在死者之丘游荡的'Kades'和'鲁盗'。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 or more Gullinbursti and Leib Olmai, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别猎杀50只或以上的狂暴野猪和狂暴大脚熊。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 45 or more Skeleton General, 20 or more Am Mut and 25 or more Gajomart, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别猎杀45只或以上的邪骸战士长、20只或以上的狂暴小土人和25只或以上的狂暴鬼火。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffThey are Old Empire's General 'Daehyon' and Guard 'Soheon'.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff它们是旧帝国的将军'Daehyon'和卫兵'Soheon'。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 or more Hell Apocalypse and Zakudam, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别猎杀50只或以上的地狱阿修罗机械战士和扎库坦。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 35 or more Heavy Metaling and Cobalt Mineral, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别猎杀35只或以上的矿石波利和钴矿石魔。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt more than 50 Banshee Masters and 30 Beholder Masters.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff猎杀50只以上的女妖首领和30只以上的大眼怪首领。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 Aunoes, and 20 Fanats.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff猎杀50只阿乌奴艾和20只法恩特。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 30 or more Knight, Blacksmith, Assassin, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别猎杀30只或以上的骑士、铁匠和刺客。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 30 or more Wizard, Priest, Hunter respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别猎杀30只或以上的巫师、牧师和猎人。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 30 or more, Crusader, Rogue, Alchemist, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别猎杀30只或以上的十字军、流氓和炼金术士。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 30 or more Sage, Monk, Bard, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别猎杀30只或以上的贤者、武僧和诗人。^000000
